newsitem.title: POLAND: IB Austria rates Jutrzenka as buy.
newsitem.headline: IB Austria rates Jutrzenka as buy.

text.p: Investmentbank Austria recommended to buy shares of Polish confectioner Jutrzenka SA, saying the firm was likely to show good profits in 1997, Investmentbank Austria said in its June report.
"We expect the company to continue showing good results this year, especially in light of lower material costs and financial income gained from the proceeds of the new share issue," it said.
It expected Jutrzenka's net profit to rise to 14.9 million zlotys in 1997 and to 19.3 million in 1998, from 10.8 million in 1996.
It said the company's sales were likely to grow to 174.7 million zlotys this year and to 247.9 million next year, from 127.9 million zlotys in 1996.
